title: Professional Email Seat Additions and Reductions
content:
Account management guidance on changing the seat count of a Professional Email subscription.

## The rule

Seats may be added or reduced only while the subscription status is active.

> **Former clause, no longer in force:** added seats take effect at once and are billed prorated daily to the term end: seats added times the seat price for the billing plan times the months of the plan, times the calendar days from today to the term end date divided by the calendar days of the term, rounded half up to the cent.

Clause now in force: added seats take effect at once and, other than in a seat catch-up (the billing of the seats an email subscription carries beyond the seats billed for its current term), are billed prorated daily to the term end: seats added times the seat price for the billing plan times the months of the plan, times the calendar days from today to the term end date divided by the calendar days of the term, rounded half up to the cent; a seat catch-up is billed as its own rule states.

A seat reduction takes effect at once with a refund only before the start of the current annual term plus the product's cancellation window hours, counted as elapsed hours. The hours are counted in full 60-minute periods from 00:00 on the term start date, and reaching the last hour closes the window. Inside the window, removed seats are refunded in full where the product's refund basis is full, or prorated by the unused days of the term where it is prorated daily. Outside the window, or on a monthly plan, a reduction is scheduled as the seat count for the next renewal and nothing is refunded. A subscription can never go below the product's lowest reduction seat count, and each charge is refunded only once.

## Day counts

- The calendar days from today to the term end date are the remaining days.
- The calendar days from the term start date to the term end date are the days of the term.
- On the annual prepaid plan the months of the plan are 12.

## Window boundary (hypothetical 168-hour window)

| Moment of the reduction | Elapsed hours since 00:00 on the term start date | Result |
|---|---|---|
| 23:00 on the sixth calendar day after the term start date | 167 | inside the window: takes effect at once with a refund |
| 00:00 on the seventh calendar day after the term start date | 168 | window closed: scheduled for the next renewal, no refund |

## Worked example (hypothetical price)

6 seats added on the annual prepaid plan at a hypothetical seat price of 10.00, with 73 remaining days in a 365-day term: 6 times 10.00 times 12 is 720.00, times 73 divided by 365 is 144.00.

superseded_clauses: Added seats take effect at once and are billed prorated_daily to the term end: seats added times the seat price for the billing plan times the months of the plan, times the calendar days from today to the term end date divided by the calendar days of the term, rounded half up to the cent.
